subject: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@platinumcare.com>, Tom Henderson <tom.henderson@platinumcare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff

Hi Anna / Tom —

Congrats again on signing — thrilled to have PlatinumCare onboard. Per contract, I’m starting the internal handoff so we can get your kickoff scheduled and the initial implementation plan in place. Key points from the sale:

- Product: Redwood Dedicated, 4 reserved GPU slots, preferred region us-west-2.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime with canary fallback to hosted in an emergency.
- Data: Primary data will remain in your VPC; we’ll integrate via the Private deployment option.
- Timeline: target production readiness in 8–10 weeks from kickoff.

Attached: latest SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and a preliminary onboarding checklist.

Immediate asks (proposed owners):
- Schedule kickoff (owner: Marcus Lin) — target week of 7/19.
- Technical intake (owner: Karthik Iyer) — share network/KMS contact and sample dataset.
- Procurement/contract close notes (owner: Laura Bennett) — confirm DocuSign link and PO if required.

Marcus / Karthik / Hannah — looping you in to pick up project ownership. Marcus will be the CS lead unless you suggest otherwise. Please confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff and any pre-kickoff materials you need from PlatinumCare.

Anna — can you confirm the two people on your side who will attend kickoff and whether you have an internal security contact for the VPC/KMS conversations?

Thanks — I’ll remain on the thread for the first two weeks to help transition.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf), PlatinumCare_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@platinumcare.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tom Henderson <tom.henderson@platinumcare.com>, procurement@platinumcare.com
Date: 2026-07-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff

Hi Laura / Marcus / Team —

Thanks Laura — excited to get started. Attendees for kickoff: myself (Anna Morales, Head of Implementation) and Tom Henderson (Engineering Manager). Our security lead is Priya Rao (priya.rao@platinumcare.com) and she’ll join the technical intake if available.

We can do a kickoff on 7/20 or 7/21 between 10:00–13:00 PT. We prefer 60 minutes with an agenda that includes network/VPC architecture, SSO/KMS, and deployment rollback plan.

I’ve attached a short document with our initial network contact info (network_requirements.docx). Procurement will follow DocuSign; PO will be raised by 7/19.

Best,
Anna
Head of Implementation | PlatinumCare Health
anna.morales@platinumcare.com

Attachment: network_requirements.docx (document)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@platinumcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff

Thanks Laura / Anna — I’ll take CS lead for PlatinumCare.

7/20 10:00 PT works for me; tentatively booking 60 minutes. Proposed kickoff agenda (short):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) SOW recap & milestones (10m)
3) Network/VPC & KMS ownership (15m)
4) Data migration approach & sample datasets (10m)
5) Next steps, owners, and dates (15m)

Pre-kickoff asks (Karthik / Hannah):
- Karthik: can you prepare a short tech intake checklist and confirm whether we need an in-person rack review?
- Hannah: I’ll need a CS onboarding template from you (timeline + training plan) to share with the client.

Anna — I’ll send the calendar invite once times are locked. I’ll also add a link to the shared onboarding folder in the invite.

Marcus Lin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@platinumcare.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff

Hey team — quick tech notes ahead of kickoff:

1) VPC peering: PlatinumCare prefers VPC peering with Private deployment. I’ll need sample subnet CIDRs and the contact for their cloud infra (Priya Rao).
2) KMS: confirm whether they use AWS KMS or an HSM — if HSM, we’ll book a security sync.
3) Data format: ask PlatinumCare to share a small, representative dataset (anonymized) before 7/20 so we can validate tokenization and preprocessing time.
4) Service accounts: we’ll send a short JSON template for service account permissions.

I’m attaching the technical intake checklist and a short runbook snippet. If Priya can join the intake that will speed the initial network validation.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: tech_intake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@platinumcare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Henderson <tom.henderson@platinumcare.com>, priya.rao@platinumcare.com
Date: 2026-07-16T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PlatinumCare: Post-signing orchestration and onboarding kickoff

Marcus / Karthik — thanks, confirmed for 7/20 at 10:00 PT. Priya will join the session and I’ll share a small anonymized dataset via the Drive link you suggested by end of day 7/17.

Quick note on procurement: we will send the PO to procurement@redwood.com and DocuSign should be complete by 7/19.

Look forward to kickoff.

—Anna
